lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][01][01]"What's all the noise[01]about? Poko, is that[01]you?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][01][01]"O que e todo esse barulho?[01]Poko, e voce?"

lines.text_source: [0C][04][14][01][01]"Well I'll be...[01]Visitors![02]Please, please--[01]come in!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][04][14][01][01]"Nossa![01]Visitantes![02]Por favor, por favor--[01]entrem!"

lines.text_source: [14][81]A"I see...So you're[01]trying to get to[01]the mainland, huh?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][81]A"Entendo... Entao voces[01]querem chegar ao[01]continente, e?"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][81]A"I've kind of settled[01]down now, but back in[01]the day,[02]I was quite the[01]adventurer myself.[02]I came here from the[01]mainland several[01]years ago."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][81]A"Agora estou assentado,[01]mas nos velhos tempos[02]eu era um aventureiro[01]de verdade.[02]Vim do continente ha[01]varios anos."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][81]A"Then of course I met[01]my wife,[02]and I ended up[01]staying here."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][81]A"E claro que conheci[01]minha esposa,[02]e acabei[01]ficando por aqui."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][81]A"I'm sorry--I haven't[01]properly introduced[01]myself! How rude![02]My name is Beyd, and[01]this is Sen, Shami,[01]Rinpo, Poske, and Peso.[02]They wanted to see[01]you--[02]we don't get many[01]visitors here, you[01]know..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][81]A"Desculpem--nao me[01]apresentei direito![02]Meu nome e Beyd, e[01]estes sao Sen, Shami,[01]Rinpo, Poske, e Peso.[02]Queriam ve-los--[02]nao recebemos muitos[01]visitantes por aqui..."
lines.risk_notes: muitos nomes; cuidado com transliiteracao e byte_budget

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][81]A"And this is Poko,[01]my wife.[02]Pretty cute, isn't[01]she?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][81]A"E esta e Poko,[01]minha esposa.[02]Bem bonitinha, nao e?"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][80]@"Pokko, pyuui![02]Ni, waama poto[01]pyuui!"
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][80]@"Pokko, pyuui![02]Ni, waama poto[01]pyuui!"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][81]A"She says your[01]wife is also[01]very beautiful."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][81]A"Ela diz que sua[01]esposa tambem e[01]muito bonita."

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][02][02]"Um...Anyway...[02]Can you tell us how[01]we can get to the[01]mainland from here?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][02][02]"Um... De qualquer[01]forma...[02]Pode nos dizer como[01]chegar ao continente[01]daqui?"

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][81]A"Oh, that's right![01]I'm sorry!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][81]A"Ah, e verdade![01]Desculpem!"

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][81]A"Well, the people who[01]told you that you can[01]get there from here[02]by crossing the flats[01]were right--you can."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][81]A"Bem, quem disse que[01]voces podem chegar la[02]atravessando os baixios[01]estava certo."

lines.text_source: [14][81]A"However, you can[01]only do so when the[01]tide changes and[02]exposes the road[01]through the flats.[02]You have to time it[01]just right, before[01]the road disappears."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][81]A"Porem, so e possivel[01]quando a mare muda e[02]expoe o caminho[01]pelos baixios.[02]Precisa sincronizar[01]direitinho, antes que[01]o caminho some."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Well? When is that?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"E quando sera?"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][80]@"Purechi, suru ko![02]Taan, kalu.[01]Pokko kairu ni."
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][80]@"Purechi, suru ko![02]Taan, kalu.[01]Pokko kairu ni."

lines.text_source: [14][81]A"She says you should[01]stay here for a[01]while.[02]She'll tell you when[01]the time comes and[01]take you there."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][81]A"Ela diz que voces[01]devem ficar aqui um[02]pouco. Ela avisara quando[01]chegar a hora e[01]levara voces."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"The Pabpab seem to[01]know when it's[01]possible to cross[02]the flats. I don't[01]know how, but they[01]do.[02]Don't worry--when[01]the time comes,[01]they'll take you."
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Os Pabpab parecem[01]saber quando e[01]possivel atravessar[02]os baixios. Nao sei[01]como, mas sabem.[02]Nao se preocupem--[01]quando chegar a hora,[01]eles levam voces."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"What!? Someone's[01]sick?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"O quê!? Alguem esta[01]doente?"

lines.text_source: [14][83]G"Yes, in that room[01]over there.[02]One of the Pabpabs[01]was crouched over[01]and moaning."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][83]G"Sim, naquele quarto[01]ali.[02]Um dos Pabpab[01]estava curvado[01]e gemendo."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"The truth is...[02]None of the herbs[01]around here can be[02]used to cure that[01]disease.[02]I've tried[01]everything,[01]but..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"A verdade e...[02]Nenhuma das ervas[01]por aqui pode[02]curar essa doenca.[02]Ja tentei[01]tudo, mas..."

lines.text_source: [14][83]G"Then...What's going[01]to happen to him!?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][83]G"Entao... O que vai[01]acontecer com ele!?"

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"Besides, the Pabpab[01]say '[05][02]pukapuka[06]'...[02]'[05][02]What will be,[01]will be[06]'...[02]It's their way of[01]life...[02]Dying doesn't seem[01]to bother them much."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Alem disso, os Pabpab[01]dizem '[05][02]pukapuka[06]'...[02]'[05][02]O que vier,[01]vira[06]'...[02]E seu jeito de viver...[02]Morrer nao parece[01]incomoda-los muito."
lines.risk_notes: pukapuka = conceito filosofico; preservar em glossario

lines.text_source: [14][C1]@"Well, it bothers me![01]We can't just let[01]him die![02]We'll go get the[01]herbs you need![02]Where can we find[01]them?"
lines.speaker: Nina
lines.base_translation: [14][C1]@"Bem, pra mim[01]incomoda![01]Nao podemos deixar[01]ele morrer![02]Vamos buscar as[01]ervas que voce precisa![02]Onde a gente acha[01]elas?"
lines.risk_notes: Nina: lideranca discreta, determinada, sentido de responsabilidade. Ton nao pode ser passivo. Risco alto por caracterizacao.

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C2]@"We can't just sit[01]around here waiting,[01]doing nothing.[02]Let us do something[01]to help pay back[01]your hospitality."
lines.speaker: Ryu
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][C2]@"Nao damos conta[01]de ficar aqui esperando[01]sem fazer nada.[02]Deixa a gente ajudar[01]a pagar sua[01]hospitalidade."
lines.risk_notes: Ryu: simples, direto, honesto. Nao verbose. Contraste com Fou-Lu critico.

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"All right then...[02]First, you'll need[01]to go to [05][02]Lyp[06]."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Ta bem entao...[02]Primeiro, voces precisa[01]ir ate [05][02]Lyp[06]."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"The herbs we need[01]can be found[02]somewhere on the[01]ocean.[02]Someone in Lyp[01]should be able to[02]tell you where to[01]find it."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"As ervas que[01]precisamos[02]podem ser achadas[01]em algum lugar no[01]oceano.[02]Alguem em Lyp[01]deve conseguir[02]te dizer onde[01]achar."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"You should be able[01]to find out something[02]about the herbs in[01]Lyp.[02]Thank you for your[01]help."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Voces deviam[01]conseguir saber algo[02]sobre as ervas em[01]Lyp.[02]Obrigado pela[01]ajuda."

lines.text_source: [0C][04][14][81]A"Did you find the[01]herbs? Thank you so[01]much.[02]Come along--let's go[01]give them to him and[01]see what happens."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][04][14][81]A"Acharam as ervas?[01]Muito obrigado.[02]Vem ca--vamos[01]dar pra ele e[01]ver o que acontece."

lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: [03] deu a erva ao Pabpab...

lines.text_source: It's working...?
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: Sera que funciona...?

lines.text_source: [0C][02][14][01][01]"Um...[0B]Thank you.[02]I don't know if it[01]will work, but[01]pukapuka...[02]We'll just have to[01]wait and see, won't[01]we?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][02][14][01][01]"Um...[0B]Obrigado.[02]Nao sei se vai[01]funcionar, mas[01]pukapuka...[02]Vamos ter que[01]esperar, nao e?"

lines.text_source: [0C][02][14][01][01]"It's late. You[01]should rest.[02]We'll see how he[01]feels in the[01]morning."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][02][14][01][01]"E noite. Voces[01]deviam descansar.[02]Vamos ver como[01]ele se sente[01]amanha."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C1]@"Look! It looks like[01]the herbs worked!"
lines.speaker: Nina
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][C1]@"Olha! Parece que[01]as ervas funcionaram!"

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"He says that[01]although he might[01]have gotten better[02]just by dancing, he's[01]sure the herbs you[01]brought helped him,[02]so he'd like to[01]thank you very much."
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Ele diz que[01]talvez tivesse melhorado[02]so dancando, mas[01]tem certeza que as ervas[01]voces trouxeram[02]ajudaram, entao[01]agradece muito."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"As I was saying,[01]'pukapuka' is their[01]way of life.[02]It means what will[01]be, will be...[02]It also has another[01]meaning--[02]that things will all[01]work out in the[01]end."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Como eu dizia,[01]'pukapuka' e seu[01]jeito de viver.[02]Significa o que[01]vier, vira...[02]Tem outro[01]significado tambem--[02]que as coisas[01]vao dar certo no[01]final."
lines.risk_notes: pukapuka = duplo significado; filosofia cultural Pabpab

lines.text_source: [14][84]G"Well, we're just[01]glad he got better.[02][14][85]GUm...He is happy he[01]got better, isn't[01]he?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][84]G"Bem, so estamos[01]felizes que melhorou.[02][14][85]GUm... Ele fica feliz[01]que melhorou,[01]nao fica?"

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"Thank you--all of[01]you--for your help."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Obrigado--todos[01]voces--pela ajuda."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][80]@"Purechi! Purechi!"
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][80]@"Purechi! Purechi!"

lines.base_translation: [14][81]A"Parece que a mare[01]esta indo embora.[02]Voces conseguem[01]atravessar os baixios[01]em breve."

lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][01][01]"Por favor, precisam[01]ir rapido.[02]O caminho pelos[01]baixios vai ficar[02]exposto por[01]pouco tempo!"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C1]@"Thank you for[01]letting us stay[01]here, Mr. Beyd!"

lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][C1]@"Obrigada por[01]nos deixar ficar[01]aqui, Sr. Beyd!"

lines.speaker: Fou-Lu
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][C5]@"[04][05] diz que[01]nos apressaremos."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C4]@"Don't worry--we'll[01]make it."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][C4]@"Nao se preocupem--[01]conseguimos."

lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][01][01]"Poko vai mostrar[01]o caminho ate os[01]baixios.[02]Boa sorte![01]Purechi pukapuka!"

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"What are you still[01]doing here?[02]You'd better hurry if[01]you want to get[01]across the flats!"
lines.speaker: system
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"O que voces ainda[01]estao fazendo aqui?[02]Melhor se apressarem[01]se querem atravessar[01]os baixios!"

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"Hello again![02]Were you able to make[01]it across the flats?"

lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Ola novamente![02]Conseguiram[01]atravessar os baixios?"
